data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001's mechanism misapplies the constant-difference heuristic and produces an unsupported residue. The heuristic for x≡a (mod m), x≡b (mod n) with a-b = b'-(n) relates the residue to a-b only when scaled by the appropriate modular inverse; the simple subtraction 3-4=-1 and 5-7=-2 does not yield x≡-2 (mod 35) by any stated valid rule. The target never derives why -2 follows from these two differences; it asserts the conclusion without a sound step. Since 18 is correct only because 18≡-2 (mod 35), the missing justification is a genuine reasoning fault, not a mere scope omission.
